description: This file contains utility functions for SuiteCRM, including configuration setup, language loading, user management, and system utilities.

methods.name: make_sugar_config
methods.description: Initializes the $sugar_config array with configuration parameters, either from existing globals or defaults.

methods.name: get_sugar_config_defaults
methods.description: Returns default configuration array for sugar_config, merging locale defaults.

methods.name: getRunningUser
methods.description: Attempts to determine the username of the user under which the PHP script is running, supporting Windows and Linux.

methods.name: addCronAllowedUser
methods.description: Adds a specified user to the allowed_cron_users list in the config, mainly for Linux systems.

methods.name: load_menu
methods.description: Loads menu PHP files for a module, deprecated in favor of SugarView::getMenu().

methods.name: get_notify_template_file
methods.description: Returns the file path of the email notification template for a specific language.

methods.name: sugar_config_union
methods.description: Merges two arrays with override, with deprecated status and unused.

methods.name: make_not_writable
methods.description: Attempts to set a file or directory as not writable, useful for security hardening.

methods.name: return_name
methods.description: Constructs a full name string from row data; deprecated and unused.

methods.name: get_languages
methods.description: Returns available language options, excluding disabled ones.

methods.name: get_all_languages
methods.description: Returns all configured languages, deprecated and unused.

methods.name: get_language_display
methods.description: Returns display label for a language key, deprecated and unused.

methods.name: get_current_language
methods.description: Returns the currently active language based on session or default config.

methods.name: get_assigned_user_name
methods.description: Fetches the name of a user given their user ID.

methods.name: get_user_name
methods.description: Fetches the username (login name) for a given user ID.

methods.name: get_authenticated_user
methods.description: Retrieves the User object of the currently authenticated user from the session.

methods.name: get_user_array
methods.description: Returns an array of users filtered by status, permissions, and other parameters, with caching support.

methods.name: getUserArrayFromFullName
methods.description: Returns an array of users matching full name criteria, considering security filters.

methods.name: showFullName
methods.description: Determines user preference for displaying full names.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Truncates a string to max length and escapes shell commands.

methods.name: safe_map
methods.description: Copies a request variable to an object's member variable if not already set.

methods.name: safe_map_named
methods.description: Copies a request variable to an object's member variable with control over copying conditions.

methods.name: return_app_list_strings_language
methods.description: Loads application list strings for a language, with caching and override support.

methods.name: return_application_language
methods.description: Loads application language strings for a language, with caching.

methods.name: return_mod_list_strings_language
methods.description: Returns a module's list strings for a language, including en_us fallback.

methods.name: return_theme_language
methods.description: Returns theme-specific language strings, deprecated and unused.

methods.name: return_session_value_or_default
methods.description: Returns a session variable if set and not empty, otherwise provides default.

methods.name: append_where_clause
methods.description: Adds a SQL where clause based on a request variable if present.

methods.name: generate_where_statement
methods.description: Constructs a combined SQL WHERE statement from an array of clauses.

methods.name: is_guid
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the format of a GUID.

methods.name: create_guid
methods.description: Generates a UUID v4 suitable for SuiteCRM record IDs, replacing legacy method.

methods.name: microtime_diff
methods.description: Calculates difference between two microtime timestamps.

methods.name: displayStudioForCurrentUser
methods.description: Returns true if the current user has admin access, controlling display of Studio.

methods.name: displayWorkflowForCurrentUser
methods.description: Sets session to control display of workflow editor.

methods.name: get_admin_modules_for_user
methods.description: Returns an array of modules where the user has admin privileges; deprecated.

methods.name: get_workflow_admin_modules_for_user
methods.description: Returns modules where user is admin in workflow, based on permissions.
